turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Let's practise. With he, she and it, the verb takes -s: I play, she plays. Some verbs take -es, like go -> goes.

Exercise: My brother ___ (go) to the gym on Fridays. Answer with only the verb.
